summary: REQ-2 logout/session-staleness appears addressed via new AuthGate gating, principal-scoped React Query keys, and continued use of the existing full-cleanup logout hook. REQ-1 is partially addressed (hardcoded admin recognition and a migration to force role=#admin for existing profiles/pending signups), but the diff evidence is insufficient to confirm that newly created/pending signups for username "sayedbaquar" are automatically stored with role #admin during normal signup/approval processing or that updateUserRole/user listing paths behave as required.

missing_requirements.requirement: Ensure a newly-signed-up user with profile.username exactly "sayedbaquar" receives stored UserProfile.role = #admin during pending signup processing (and thus passes isCallerAdmin()).
missing_requirements.reason: The diff shows a migration that updates existing stable userProfiles/pendingSignups and a hardcoded-admin check used in AccessControl role determination, but it does not show normal-time signup/pending-signup processing logic that assigns/forces profile.role to #admin for new signups.

missing_requirements.requirement: Admin-only user listing shows user "sayedbaquar" with role "Admin" (Role.admin).
missing_requirements.reason: No user-listing implementation is shown/confirmed in the provided backend diff snippet; therefore it cannot be verified that the listing will display the stored role as Admin for this user.

missing_requirements.requirement: Attempting to set "sayedbaquar" to admin via the existing updateUserRole pathway results in admin permissions being granted without silent downgrade due to allowlist checks.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff shows determineAccessControlRole allowing admin when profile.role == #admin and (allowlisted OR hardcoded username), but the updateUserRole pathway itself is not shown; cannot confirm it persists role=#admin for this user and updates AccessControl accordingly.
